items.name: citation-verifier
items.title: Citation Verifier
items.description: Audit every citation in a chapter, paper, or proposal against the .bib file and the real world: each cite key must exist, each entry must resolve to a live DOI or arXiv record whose title, authors, and year match, and each claim attributed to a source must be supported by that source's note or text. Reports unverified, mismatched, and unsupported citations with the fix. Use before sending a draft to a supervisor, before submission, or whenever text was drafted with AI assistance and a fabricated reference would be fatal.
items.author: Khaled Saeed
